target_customer: Individual retail and semi-professional traders in crypto and onchain markets, paying through trading fees
problem: Covering thousands of markets around the clock needs analysts and quants that an individual trader cannot afford. Instinct packages that research and monitoring as a team of AI agents.
business_model: Trading platform with per-trade fees (the site advertises about $1 on a $10,000 trade); agents and research tools bundled
product_category: AI trading agents and trading app

founders.name: Eunju Moon
education: USC PhD in quantum computing (dropped out)

competitors.name: Senpi
competitors.what: Personal AI trading agents for Hyperliquid with copy trading and autonomous modes

technical_complexity.rationale: Agent orchestration over market data, news and social feeds plus order execution on onchain venues is standard LLM agent engineering with hard reliability and risk-control parts. Founders have quant and research backgrounds.

defensibility.rationale: Many open-source and vendor AI trading agents for Hyperliquid were launching in 2026, so the agent layer is easy to copy. Any edge would come from a social copy-trading network or user trust, which is unproven.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent action found as of the sources; the field was crowded with small agent products.

market_need_then: Onchain perpetuals volume was growing (Hyperliquid open interest reported above $10 billion by mid-2026) and AI agent tooling made 24/7 automated research feasible. Evidence of paid demand for Instinct itself was not found.

branding.domain_note: Uses instinct.xyz, not the .com. A separate, much larger AI assistant company also called Instinct raised large rounds in 2026, which creates search confusion.

identity.logo: Logo files exist but no source describes the design
identity.voice_and_tone: Confident, bold and trader-casual: 'Trade with superhuman instinct', 'Spot mooners'

branding.community_and_virality: Early access by waitlist; no source shows fan communities or merch.

brand_strength.rationale: Strong, simple tagline and a memorable word, but name collision with a heavily covered same-named AI assistant and little independent press about the brand.

outcome_analysis: Instinct is a Winter 2026 company with a five person team and no disclosed outcome. It has launched a waitlist for AI trading agents aimed at traders who want an investment-firm toolset. The main risks visible today are a crowded field of Hyperliquid agent products and name confusion with a different Instinct that raised far more money.
notes: No funding for this company was found in any outlet; search results about $250M and $1B rounds belong to a different company named Instinct (personal AI assistant) and were excluded. The footer of instinct.xyz credits Assonant, Inc. as the operator. A wiki says the launch announcement was made in October, but that wiki is secondary and unverified. Funding search and cross-check both returned nothing for this company.
